title: EU hosting region for the analytics add-on
purpose: We launch the analytics add-on to EU customers in Q1 and must pick where its data lives before the infrastructure ticket is scheduled on 2026-11-24.
decision: Which hosting option the analytics add-on uses for EU customers at launch.
use_of_answers: Answers go into the decision record on the Analytics wiki; both recipients see each other's answers before the record is signed off.
context: The add-on stores event data per customer workspace. Today everything runs in our US region. Three enterprise prospects in Germany and France asked where their data will live, and two contracts in negotiation mention EU residency. Engineering estimates any EU region adds roughly four weeks of setup; the open question is which option is acceptable on compliance and cost grounds, not how to build it.
default_if_no_answer: If no answer arrives by 2026-11-20 we proceed with option A (Frankfurt) and record that the choice was made without Security and Finance input.

options.label: Dedicated EU region in Frankfurt
options.tradeoffs: Strongest residency story for German prospects; adds about EUR 3,800/month and a second on-call surface.

options.label: Dedicated EU region in Dublin
options.tradeoffs: Same residency story, about EUR 3,200/month; latency to DACH customers is 10-15 ms higher.

options.label: Stay in the US region under contractual safeguards
options.tradeoffs: No extra cost or setup; at least two current deals may stall on residency clauses.

options.label: None of these / something else
options.tradeoffs: Describe the alternative in Q5 so we can cost it.
